checkpoint.title: Level Paras into Spore Parasect (Lv 27) with Rare Candies

events.why: Evolve Paras into Parasect at Lv 24 and teach Spore at Lv 27 (Gen 3 FireRed learnset).

metadata.notes: Starts outside Route 4's Pokemon Center with Paras and Rare Candies from frlg.team_training in the bag. Evolves Paras to Parasect with Spore (Lv 27). Pair with Scyther from 09-shiny-scyther (arrives at Lv 25 already knowing False Swipe). Use frlg.team_training to stock Rare Candies and optionally level both higher (Lv 70-100) before running frlg.dex_collection.
